read.thesis: Steel pricing up to $1,298/ton with record 3.7Mt shipments and steel operating income $721M, but mill utilisation is high and aluminum start-up losses persist; supply discipline is not discussed.

utilisation.quote: as domestic steel mills increased utilization

triggers.label: Steel price $1,298/ton, up $105 QoQ
triggers.quote: The second quarter 2026 average external product selling price for the company’s steel operations increased $105 sequentially to $1,298 per ton.

triggers.label: Customer inventories below norms
triggers.quote: customer inventory levels declined, remaining lower than historical norms

triggers.label: Fabrication backlog ~45% higher YoY
triggers.quote: the order backlog now nearly 45 percent higher than a year ago and extending into the first quarter 2027

triggers.label: Domestic trade actions support pricing
triggers.quote: supported by domestic trade actions, manufacturing reshoring, infrastructure program funding

guidance.quote: expects volumes and profitability from its aluminum operations to increase sharply in the second half 2026 and for full year 2027
with expectations for automotive sales to commence before the end of 2026

guidance.metric: Third aluminum cold mill commercial transition
guidance.quote: with expectations to begin transitioning to commercial operations in August

red_flags.label: Working capital build; receivables up $760M YTD
red_flags.quote: Working capital, excluding income taxes increased $225 million in the second quarter

red_flags.label: Aluminum start-up losses and impairment
red_flags.quote: There was also an additional non-cash impairment charge of $16 million in the second quarter
